decision_input_coverage.note: Coverage of the selected model's declared inputs, not a probability of valuation accuracy or investment success. roe.label: Return on ending equity

warnings: Method research_risk_indicator_v1; category operating_company; policy SHA-256 8dda86b3cb49a7d8770e0142162b8126fb9e96fab02188edf239dcc188134989.

Fixed uncalibrated research heuristics, not a probability of loss/default, regulatory assessment or permission to invest. Categories have different policies and scores are not empirically calibrated across categories.
The indicator does not establish debt maturities, covenant headroom, finance-lease scope, earnings quality or liquidity adequacy.

Statement ratios use the latest sourced fiscal year and ending assets; price variability uses a separately dated market window. These periods are explicit, not represented as a common-date risk measurement.

assumptions: Policy common_equity_distribution_v1; min(latest signed annual diluted EPS, arithmetic mean of latest three) = 18.7700 USD per quoted common share.
Cost of equity 10.18%: risk-free 4.67%, equity premium 5.00%, policy beta 1.101; minimum 7%.
These are explicit forecast-policy assumptions, not a signed company-specific appraisal or a measured payout capacity.
Observed annual revenue CAGR 2.52%; initial earnings growth assumption 2.52%, fading to 2% over five years.
Assumed marginal return on new equity starts at 12.00% and fades to cost of equity by year five; next-year growth is funded by retained earnings at growth/return, capped at 80% retention.
Terminal marginal return equals the cost of equity; growth consumes capital and produces no perpetual excess return.
No second deduction of debt, leases, minority or preferred claims, and no separate cash/investment credit: the model starts with diluted earnings attributable to common shareholders.
Scenario bounds vary earnings/distributions and discount assumptions; they are not statistical confidence intervals.
Relative prices are displayed separately and never averaged into this equity distribution estimate.

policy.growth_source: aligned three-year revenue CAGR; no buyback-driven EPS growth extrapolation
policy.marginal_roe_fade: linear to cost of equity by year five; each distribution funds next-year growth
policy.model_selection: fixed by business type, never by which model gives a higher value
policy.normalization: min(latest signed annual diluted EPS, arithmetic mean of latest three)
policy.not_calibrated_to: market prices, selection counts, historical returns or probability of profit
policy.valuation_scope: common-equity going-concern distribution scenario; no separate asset liquidation credit

resolved_assumptions.normalization: min(latest signed annual diluted EPS, arithmetic mean of latest three)

warnings: Three annual diluted common-share EPS observations; losses and zero earnings are retained. This is not TTM EPS.
Common-share EPS already reflects the reported financing costs and ownership allocation; these observations do not establish an enterprise-value bridge.
Damodaran implied ERP unavailable; configured fallback used (ValueError).
Accounting earnings are not free cash flow. Distribution capacity is a scenario assumption; future refinancing, dilution, reinvestment and regulatory restrictions may differ.
The model does not appraise surplus assets, liquidation proceeds or corporate restructurings. A price above its range is conditional on this going-concern policy.
The earnings normalization can understate rapidly improving earnings or overstate recoverability after structural deterioration; it is not a forward consensus forecast.
